Repeat from step 2 any number of times.

Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.

Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
1742-3967-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
